evidence.environment: Clean exact detached Linux candidate; paired Windows source review only; Release/OFF CLI probe
evidence.observation: Reviewed the two-commit, 18-path combined candidate, paired Windows source, changelog, private transport and source assertions. The sole new Unreleased entry uses the Observability tag, gives a concise scoped behavior and practical benefit, and links #21. Exact diff whitespace and clean source passed. Read the current native prerequisite graph and readied issue after independently checking actual remote master, nine merged prerequisite PRs in that base, issue #21 open, parent #8 open, and readiness comment 6866784469. Proposed PR body has the six required headings and closes only #21. Its present scope remains unready because the known zero case is misreported. Exact Release/OFF standalone and master each exit 1 for absent requested hash fff in the complete synthetic selection.foz, but emit scope=incomplete discovery=complete selected=0 selected_total=unknown. The same summary says discovery is incomplete even with complete preparation. Unknown extent is correct when a required archive is absent; both modes then report discovery=incomplete. A complete required archive with an explicitly unavailable optional source also has an exact zero in the eligible scope, yet both modes report scope=incomplete selected_total=unknown instead of retaining the optional-input scope. An optional-only unavailable archive without a hash request correctly stays successful with scope=optional-inputs discovery=incomplete selected_total=known. See final1-missing-hash.log and final1-scope-contrast.log. The source folds hash_found into scope_satisfied before setting selected_total_known; scope() then derives the incomplete label from that flag.

findings.evidence: Exact Release/OFF standalone and master each exit 1 for absent requested hash fff in the complete synthetic selection.foz, but emit scope=incomplete discovery=complete selected=0 selected_total=unknown.
